text: {"lessons":["I will review concentration and downside risk regularly, rather than letting substantial declines pass without reassessing whether my holdings still fit my plan.","I will judge each stock by its outlook and role in my portfolio, not by its purchase price; avoiding a realized loss is not a reason to keep holding.","I will set consistent rules for trimming or exiting positions so that fear of losses, relief at selling, or infrequent account checks do not drive my decisions."]}
